description:
Spee24 Shopping is your AI-powered smart shopping companion. Find thousands of products from Spee24 Shop, compare prices, uncover the best deals, and get tailored recommendations instantly. Shop confidently with AI that finds the right product, every time.

How to Use Spee24 Shopping in ChatGPT

Just type @Spee24 Shopping followed by what you're looking for — no setup needed every time.

Ask anything:

"Find me summer dresses"
"Find birthday gifts for my mother"
"Compare red lipsticks"

defaultPrompt: find me VERY J Tropical Printed Midi Summer Boho Dress
